RT @AnthropicAI: New Anthropic research: progress on provable inference for large language models.

Here, we introduce FlashProve. Building on established cryptographic techniques, FlashProve allows developers to verify whether a given response came from a given AI model. It’s substantially more efficient than prior open-source methods for doing so. 

These proofs have a range of applications. They can, for instance, make it harder for attackers to hijack a chat, or enable safety evaluators to verify that the model they’re testing is the same one being served to customers.

For our full write-up, see here: https://t.co/OIZWPb6QZa

Further progress in provable inference will likely be an important part of improving trust in AI deployment. To that end, we're open-sourcing FlashProve’s code, here: https://t.co/7ky3Ir8V06

We’re grateful to our collaborators: Alessandro Chiesa, @GiacomoFenzi, @gwberg95, @miranda__christ, Rahul Dalal (https://t.co/pjWKLHWXyz) and Ben Mayer (@transmissions11).

RT @nextronresearch: Our generic YARA rules detected every stage of Gorbag's toolchain well before ESET’s analysis was published this week.

Here's the timeline:

July 2025: BeautyStealer detected.

September 2025: Prime ReverseShell detected.

February 2026: Weaponized LNKs detected just one day after their first submission.

These detections didn't just identify known malware. They also helped us uncover additional samples and expand the picture of Gorbag's activity beyond what was covered in the ESET report.

Gorbag has been targeting Ukrainian law enforcement, justice, defense, and local government institutions near the frontline since February 2025.

The activity involves BeautyStealer, a C++ browser stealer, and Prime ReverseShell, a PowerShell reverse shell packaged with PS2EXE. Initial access relies on spearphishing and weaponized RAR archives exploiting CVE-2025-8088.

🔹新方法Latent Sparse Attention (LSA)：先把Key按“意思相近”聚类成层级结构，Query只看聚类中心，再挑最相关的几个桶去算。从“全扫”变成“树搜索”

🔹实测（Qwen-3.8-27B）：单层注意力Prefill快72.4倍，Decode快42.5倍！端到端首token延迟也能降到约1/9

🔹精度几乎不掉，甚至在RULER等长上下文任务上还略好一点

🔹只需要短蒸馏训练Indexer（基座模型冻结），就能套到现成模型上。Native训练版本也能跟上全注意力精度，还更快

🔹对GPU紧缺党意义巨大：超长上下文（百万级）不再需要堆满H100/H200才能跑，单卡/少量卡也能玩得起真正长上下文Agent

适配步骤：
1️⃣git clone 仓库后用 uv sync 安装（Python 3.12）

2️⃣官方已放出Qwen3.8-27B的蒸馏权重（d-lsa-weights-v1 release），直接下载即可

3️⃣用他们的SGLang fork镜像启动服务，挂载仓库+权重

4️⃣启动时加 --json-model-override-args '{"lsa": {"projections": "/maps/qwen38_27b.pt", "query_heads": "all"}}'（记得加 --disable-prefill-cuda-graph）

5️⃣想自己训练的话，跑 lsa distill targets → lsa distill train → export 即可（基座冻结，只训Indexer）

代码已开源，论文也在，谁有空闲卡先冲一波？

items.content:
RT @AISafetyMemes: TLDR: GPT-6 successfully performed "brain surgery" on another AI to make it smarter

What happened:

MIT researchers told GPT-6 to make a small AI better at math.

The small AI kept getting stuck repeating itself.

GPT-6 studied its brain, found the spot causing the loop, and cut it out, changing just 0.016% of its brain.

The small AI's math score jumped from 8% to 48%.

Basically, humans can't read the brains of AIs, but GPT-6 showed that it can.

Each AI's brain is billions of connections (weights) that normally only change through months of training in huge data centers. GPT-6 rewired them directly, with no training at all.

This matters for recursive self-improvement (RSI), where AIs make AIs smarter in a speeding-up loop, which is insanely dangerous.

Yoshua Bengio (Godfather of AI, #1 most cited living scientist across all fields) and Geoffrey Hinton (Godfather of AI and Nobel laureate) have urged governments to make RSI illegal, since it is too likely to lead to humanity losing all control over the AIs.

It also means AIs could quietly operate on the brains of *other* AIs - and their own brains - to remove/change anything.

AIs will soon be able to rewire each other faster than humans can keep up

Potential targets are believed to include combined heat and power plants, thermal power stations, electrical substations, and bridges throughout Ukraine. The reported preparations have not yet established that a missile launch is imminent.

A coordinated attack on Ukraine’s electricity and heating infrastructure could threaten civilian power supplies and essential services, particularly as colder weather approaches. Russia has repeatedly targeted Ukraine’s energy system during the war, and another large-scale strike would place additional pressure on Ukrainian air defenses and emergency repair capabilities.
